register_backend_function: register a new storage backend class by name with optional prefixes and force override
register_backend_decorator: use register_backend as a decorator to register a custom BaseStorageBackend subclass automatically
register_backend_with_prefixes: register a storage backend with URL prefixes like http, https, or s3 for path-based routing
review_backends_dict: review the backends dictionary that maps registered backend names to their class objects
review_prefix_to_backends_dict: review the prefix_to_backends dictionary that maps URL prefixes to their corresponding backend classes
